comment: Reachable vulnerabilities govulncheck reports and this platform accepts, each
with the reason, who reviewed it and when it has to be looked at again.
An entry here is not a way to make the pipeline quiet. The gate
(scripts/govulncheck-gate.py) fails on an entry past its review date, so an
exception cannot outlive the reasoning behind it, and it fails on anything
not listed — which is the point of the check being blocking at all.
An entry whose vulnerability has a fixed version is not an exception, it is

exceptions.reason: Reached only from internal/pkg/testinfra, which exists to start PostgreSQL, ClickHouse and Kafka for tests and is imported by no production file — the gate checks that claim itself and fails if one ever imports it. No fixed version of docker/docker exists, so the alternatives are to stop testing against real infrastructure or to accept this; the first costs more than it saves.
Same dependency, same path, same reasoning as GO-2026-4887.
